analytic_estimator.construction: construct the paired factorial effect within each event-replication, estimate each event variance with ddof=1, divide by R, and sum equal-event contributions divided by E^2

audit_classification_rules.audit_unresolved: a non-finite or otherwise unclassified disagreement remains
audit_classification_rules.finite_replication_instability: the ownership audit passes, both estimators are finite with non-degenerate variance, but the final 15% gate fails
audit_classification_rules.formula_or_ownership_mismatch: the static ownership audit finds different cell coefficients, event weights, replication identities, divisors or order of paired construction
audit_classification_rules.gate_pass: the final relative disagreement is at most 15%
audit_classification_rules.variance_floor_or_degeneracy: the final analytic and replication-index MCSE are both at most 1e-12, or all event-level effect variances are zero

across_event_aggregation.analytic: sum of event-specific conditional Monte Carlo variances; event random streams are independently keyed by event_id
across_event_aggregation.replication_index: variance of the equal-event mean over common replication indices; finite samples include sampled cross-event covariance

estimator_ownership_audit.candidate_ownership: one fixed objective-blind candidate at a time
estimator_ownership_audit.divisor_and_degrees_of_freedom: both use sample variance with ddof=1 and divide by the number of replications through sd/sqrt(R)
estimator_ownership_audit.event_weighting: equal event weight after paired effect construction
estimator_ownership_audit.non_finite_observations: rejected by the shared metric validator
estimator_ownership_audit.paired_replication_identity: registry-A event and replication identities are matched before the eight cell values are combined
estimator_ownership_audit.within_event_covariance: retained because the signed eight-cell effect is constructed before the event-level variance is estimated

extension_rule: extend uniformly to R=128 only if both estimators target the same estimand and any R=64 moment-effect gate remains below 15/16
factorial_effect_formula: one quarter times the sum over all eight cells of the signed factor-product multiplied by the cell event-replication value

replication_index_estimator.construction: construct the paired factorial effect within each event-replication, average equally across events at each replication index, and use sd(ddof=1)/sqrt(R)
replication_index_estimator.replication_identity: the exact registry-A replication index shared across cells; event streams remain independently event-keyed
